title: M3 washer
prompt: Can you make me a washer for M3 screws? 3.2 mm hole, 7 mm outside diameter, 1 mm thick. I'm going to print a bunch of them.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
7 mm across and 1 mm thick (any orientation), ±0.05 mm
Two cylindrical faces: the outer rim and the bore
Volume π/4·(7² − 3.2²)·1 ≈ 30.44 mm³ ±1% (a 3.4 mm hole would be 3.4% off)

notes: DIN 125 M3 washer is 3.2 x 7 x 0.5; thickened to 1 mm for printing. Extrude or revolve both pass.
